text: I found the local MealPrep conversation records. I’ll export readable transcripts and structured message/tool logs into a ZIP in the project folder, including the earlier MealPrep location.

name: exec
input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"$exportDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) ('conversation-exports\\MealPrep-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $exportDir -Force | Out-Null; $index = @(); $roots = @('C:\\Users\\laral\\.codex\\sessions','C:\\Users\\laral\\.codex\\archived_sessions'); foreach ($root in $roots) { if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $root)) { continue }; foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Filter '*.jsonl') { $first = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -TotalCount 1 | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($first.type -ne 'session_meta' -or $first.payload.cwd -notmatch '(?i)[\\\\/]MealPrep([\\\\/]|$)') { continue }; $id = $first.payload.id; if (!$id) { $id = $first.payload.session_id }; $md = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new(); $json = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new(); $md.Add('# MealPrep conversation'); $md.Add(''); $md.Add('Task: ' + $id); $md.Add('Project: ' + $first.payload.cwd); $count = 0; foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName) { try { $r = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }; if ($r.type -ne 'response_item') { continue }; $p = $r.payload; if ($p.type -eq 'message' -and $p.role -in @('user','assistant') -and $p.channel -ne 'analysis') { $parts = @(); foreach ($part in $p.content) { if ($part.type -in @('input_text','output_text','text')) { $parts += $part.text } elseif ($part.type -in @('input_image','image')) { $parts += '[Image attachment; original media not bundled]' } }; $body = $parts -join \"`n`n\"; if (!$body -or $body.StartsWith('<environment_context>') -or $body.StartsWith('<recommended_plugins>')) { continue }; $entry = [ordered]@{timestamp=$r.timestamp;type='message';role=$p.role;text=$body}; $json.Add(($entry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress)); $md.Add(\"`n## \" + $p.role + ' — ' + $r.timestamp + \"`n\"); $md.Add($body); $count++ } elseif ($p.type -in @('function_call','function_call_output','custom_tool_call','custom_tool_call_output','web_search_call')) { $entry = [ordered]@{timestamp=$r.timestamp;type=$p.type;name=$p.name;call_id=$p.call_id;arguments=$p.arguments;input=$p.input;output=$p.output}; $json.Add(($entry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 -Compress)) } }; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Join-Path $exportDir ($id + '.md')), $md); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Join-Path $exportDir ($id + '.jsonl')), $json); $index += [pscustomobject]@{task_id=$id;cwd=$first.payload.cwd;messages=$count;log_records=$json.Count} } }; $index | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $exportDir 'index.json') -Encoding utf8; $readme = @('# MealPrep conversation export','','Snapshot: ' + (Get-Date -Format o),'','Includes locally stored Codex sessions whose recorded project path is MealPrep or a subfolder, including the earlier Documents location. Each task has a readable Markdown transcript and a JSONL file with messages and tool calls/results. index.json lists task IDs and record counts.','','System/developer instructions, internal reasoning, and runtime metadata are excluded. Images and external attachments are not bundled. Current conversations are snapshots at export time; deleted or unavailable records cannot be recovered.'); $readme | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $exportDir 'README.md') -Encoding utf8; Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $exportDir '*') -DestinationPath ($exportDir + '.zip'); $index | Format-Table; Get-Item -LiteralPath ($exportDir + '.zip') | Select-Object FullName,Length","max_output_tokens":2000}));
